tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Cards sit on it one step lighter in light mode.

tokens.name: card-background
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups and sheets. Carries the soft card shadow in light mode; no shadow in dark.

tokens.name: card-secondary
tokens.usage: Nested surfaces: search fields, segmented tracks, chips at rest, nested panels, stepper tracks.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Selected segment and stepper buttons, raised above a card-secondary track.

tokens.name: sheet-background
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary ink: headings, body, data values.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: captions, section labels, placeholders, icons at rest. Passes AA on background, card-background and card-secondary in both themes.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Outlined input border at rest, secondary button border, sheet grabber.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of the calorie ring and progress bars.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Resting chart bars; the highlighted bar uses tint.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Slate indigo, the main accent: primary actions, selection, focus, calorie ring.

tokens.name: tint-soft
tokens.usage: Soft buttons, selected rows, the active tab pill and icon tiles. Tint text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tint fill (primary button, selected chip).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Acknowledgement only: streaks, records, celebrations. Never a warning.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind ember content: streak chip, record tag, celebration banner.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation, allowed states, the synced dot. Light value passes text contrast.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind success icons.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. No longer equals the protein color.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Destructive button background.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: protein
tokens.usage: Protein macro visualization exclusively. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: carbs
tokens.usage: Carbohydrate macro visualization exclusively. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: fat
tokens.usage: Fat macro visualization exclusively. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: target-energy
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking the calories a food being picked would add to the energy target bar.

tokens.name: target-protein
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking what the food being picked adds to the protein bar.

tokens.name: target-carbs
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking what the food being picked adds to the carbs bar.

tokens.name: target-fat
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking what the food being picked adds to the fat bar.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one big number on a screen (40 to 64). Tabular figures.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels above lists. Secondary ink.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value, between stacked bars.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps, icon to text, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards (12 on settings lists).

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, row horizontal padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding (18 vertical).

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Large separations between screen regions.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: 32 px icon tiles (12 to 16 for 40 to 52 px tiles).

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, stepper tracks.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons (large 16, small 11), nested panels, search field, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-list
tokens.usage: List groups.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and banners.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Floating tab shell, workout pill, sticky footers, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a segmented control.
